profile.headline: Software Test Engineer | Test Automation | Selenium | Python |  Typescript | API Testing | Playwright | LLM Testing
profile.summary:
Test Automation Engineer with 5+ years of experience designing, developing, and maintaining automated testing frameworks for web applications and RESTful API services. Strong expertise in Selenium, C#, and Python. Proven track record of leading cross-functional QA initiatives and building AI powered solutions to enhance testing efficiency.

Experienced in:
• Test automation and framework development
• Functional, Regression, API, Performance, Localization, Integration Testing
• CI/CD automation with Jenkins and GitHub Actions
• Selenium, Playwright, and Cucumber
• C#, Java, and Python
• Jira, X-Ray, and TestRail
• OpenAI SDK, Cursor, OpenRouter

I enjoy building automation and AI-powered solutions that help engineering teams test, measure, and release software with greater confidence.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented a localization-ready automation testing framework using Selenium and C#

• Migrated test cases to Playwright + Typescript

• Integrated automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions to automate QA build and release sign offs.

• Collaborated with AppSec teams to integrate application security into the test suite by automating SQLi and XSS scenarios, allowing security vulnerabilities to be detected early in the development lifecycle.

• Collaborated with development, product, and customer success teams to create detailed test plans, test cases, and triage application bugs.

• Mentored offshore QA and Dev engineers through training sessions, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Selenium · Test Automation · Test Planning · OpenAI API · Agentic Automation · Cursor AI

positions.title: Software Engineer In Test
positions.description:
•	Worked collaboratively on a scrum team with several developers to design and develop automated 
        tests cases for newly created features.
•	Provided testing insights in all scrum-related meetings to help increase the team velocity by 
        meeting the DOD requirements and having PSPIs each sprint.
•	Created and executed manual and automated test scripts for GUI and API tests using Robot 
        Framework.
•	Created, documented, and analyzed Performance Test results using NeoLoad software.
•	Deployed feature code to testing environments using Octopus/Jenkins.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Worked collaboratively within an Agile Team to write high quality, testable code.
•	Performed instrumentation on applications deployed on web servers
•	Automated, documented, and performed manual testing for new features 
•	Wrote, debugged, and deployed testbeds to setup environments used by all engineers

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Contributed to research using Microsoft Smart Bands to detect and classify human social gestures. Analyzed and labeled accelerometer datasets for machine-learning model development.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Taught group and individual computer literacy courses to adults at the health center, helped students build professional resumes, and taught students the basic usage of Microsoft Suites

volunteerExperiences.description: I have been volunteering with DSEF since it’s launch in 2008. Every year I volunteer to help with the organization’s “Back 2 School Extravaganza” and “Operation Give Back” programs. There is currently a “Girls Code” program launching this summer where I will be teaching young girls in the community how to code.
